design.decision: Whether to bid one more trick to top the opponents' total, knowing a set doubles the loss as well; the last bidder weighs this hardest.
design.opponent: Revealed at the first scoring; after that the opponents can bid up to deny it, at the risk of being set themselves.
design.rationale: A broad, interactive Bid High ×mult: it fires about half the time, raises the stakes with the bid (it applies on sets), and turns bidding into a contest instead of a fixed threshold; it differs from ub-outbid-mult in category and power.
design.draftText: ×2 contract multiplier when your team bids more than the opponents

critic.concerns: Clean and interactive; the last bidder has an information edge, which is ordinary Spades and visible to everyone.
